lines.en: label iospring5:
scene black
The roseate spoonbill’s colors are the brightest early May.
lines.zh: 玫瑰琵鹭的颜色在五月初最为鲜艳。

lines.en: The crowning jewel of avians in threskiornithidae.
lines.zh: 鹮科鸟类中最璀璨的冠上明珠。

lines.en: Its favorite meal, carotenoids — they paint its wings in pink
lines.zh: 它最爱的食物是类胡萝卜素——它们把它的翅膀染成粉色，

lines.en: While astaxanthin lies in wait and hydrocarbons sink.
lines.zh: 而虾青素潜伏一旁，碳氢化合物沉入水底。

lines.en: scene krill
why do i still try so hard
lines.zh: 为什么我还要这么努力

lines.en: scene iofinallywins1
: Uta! Look! We’d totally die if we fell from here right now!
lines.zh: : Uta！快看！要是我们现在从这儿掉下去，肯定得死！

lines.en: : Yeah, but...is that really something you want to be excited about?
lines.zh: : 是啊，但是……这真的是值得你兴奋的事吗？

lines.en: Before the dialogue drifts further into unintended, unwanted, or uncertain directions, I want to take a minute to interrupt this Io event for the sake of shining a light on the rapidly declining mental state of me and my cat.
lines.zh: 在对话进一步滑向不必要、不受欢迎或不确定的方向之前，我想花一分钟打断这个 Io 事件，好让聚光灯照一照我和我的猫那急转直下的精神状态。

lines.en: It all started one week when the sun was shining. Everything was good and I had just finished cloaking the outdoor plants and pipes in various quilts to shield them from the impending endless cold.
lines.zh: 一切始于阳光明媚的某一周。一切都很好，我刚把户外的植物和管道用各种棉被裹好，替它们挡住即将到来的无尽严寒。

lines.en: When I came back inside, I noticed a shine on the floor I couldn’t quite explain. Did someone wax it while I wasn’t looking? Unlikely. Was it dissolving? Also unlikely. It had to be a trick.
lines.zh: 等我回到屋里，我注意到地板上有一种我说不太清楚的光泽。是有人趁我不注意给地板打了蜡？不太可能。是它在溶解？也不太可能。那一定是错觉。

lines.en: So I went upstairs, gripping the railing on the right as it fits my dominant hand better, hoping that today isn’t the day I accidentally pry it off of the wall and fall to my death. When, at the top of the stairs, I notice him.
lines.zh: 于是我上了楼，右手抓着扶栏，因为惯用手抓起来更顺，同时希望今天别是我一不小心把它从墙上拽下来、摔死的那天。就在楼梯顶端，我注意到了他。

lines.en: His mouth is open in an attempt to meow, but no sound comes out. I mock him. He hates me. He tries again. No sound. I mock him again. Why can I meow, but he can not?
lines.zh: 他张着嘴想喵一声，却一点声音都没发出来。我嘲笑他。他恨我。他又试了一次。还是没声音。我又嘲笑了他一次。为什么我能喵，他却不能？

lines.en: Have I been the cat this whole time? Has he been the human? Are words just arbitrary things we use to signify and explain ideas that can be better explained and emphasized by the balls in our eyes alone?
lines.zh: 难道一直以来我才是那只猫？他才是那个人？语言会不会只是我们用来指代和解释想法的随意之物——而那些想法，其实用我们眼窝里那两颗球就能解释和强调得更好？

lines.en: We sat on the couch. He curled up beside me. This is a lie.
lines.zh: 我们坐在沙发上。他蜷在我旁边。这是谎话。

lines.en: I went to my room and locked him out behind a gate. He always disturbs me. He’s meowing right now. I can hear him. I know it came back. He was merely deceiving me.
lines.zh: 我回了房间，用一道门把他关在外面。他总是打扰我。他现在就在喵喵叫。我听得见。我知道那声音又回来了。他只是在骗我。

lines.en: That bastard. I will never forgive him. But more than that, I will never forgive myself for succumbing to the pressure of existing for the sole purpose of existing.
lines.zh: 那个混蛋。我永远不会原谅他。但更重要的是，我永远不会原谅自己——屈服于仅仅为了存在而存在所带来的压力。

lines.en: “When did this become so boring?” I ask myself, asking myself. “What was the meaning of that phone call?”
lines.zh: 「这一切是从什么时候开始变得这么无聊的？」我问自己，问我自己。「那通电话到底是什么意思？」

lines.en: Anyway, that’s it. Back to Io.
lines.zh: 总之，就这样。回到 Io。

lines.en: : Of course it’s something to be excited about! Any situation where you’re close to death is something to be excited about! It’s why amusement parks are so cool!
lines.zh: : 当然是值得兴奋的事！任何离死亡很近的处境都值得兴奋！这就是为什么游乐园那么酷！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins2
: That’s why they’re cool? Not because they’re little urban sanctuaries filled with fun rides and assorted street foods?
lines.zh: : 所以它们酷是因为这个？不是因为它们是充满有趣游乐设施和各式街头小吃的城市小圣地？

lines.en: : Those help too! But more than anything, they’re fun because they give us a chance to experience things we’d never be able to in real life!
lines.zh: : 那些也有帮助啦！但最重要的原因是，它们让我们有机会去体验现实中永远体验不到的东西！

lines.en: : But...this is real life right now.
lines.zh: : 可是……我们现在就处在现实里啊。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins3

: Technically speaking, yes. But amusement parks exist in a special area between real real life and fake real life. Which is also known as fiction. Which is also known as where I want to be because it hurts less.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，是的。但游乐园存在于「真实的现实」和「虚假的现实」之间的一片特殊地带。也就是所谓的虚构。也就是我想待着的地方，因为那里没那么疼。

lines.en: : You’re weird. Are you experimenting with new drugs again?
lines.zh: : 你好奇怪。你又在试新药了吗？

lines.en: : No, I’m just happy I’m finally here.
lines.zh: : 没有，我只是很高兴自己终于到这儿了。

lines.en: scene black
: Me too! I don’t get to see you actually have fun very often.
lines.zh: : 我也是！我可不常看到你真的玩得开心。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins4
: I’m sorry it’s with me and not Sensei, though. I know he’s the one you really wanted to come with.
lines.zh: : 不过我很抱歉，陪你来的是我而不是 Sensei。我知道你真正想一起来的那个人是他。

lines.en: : Don’t be sorry at all! You’re just as high up in the Io ranking as he is. And it’s not like I was aiming for it to be a date, so this is perfect as far as I’m concerned! I just don’t know why it took us so long to come here.
lines.zh: : 一点都别抱歉！你在 Io 排行榜里的位置跟他一样高。再说我又没打算让它变成约会，所以对我来说这样最完美了！我只是不明白我们为什么拖了这么久才来。

lines.en: : Our schedules don’t always match up because of work and school. Like, when was the last time we both had an entire weekend off?
lines.zh: : 因为工作和上学，我们的时间总是对不上。就好比，我们俩上一次整个周末都休息是什么时候？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins5
: Probably...never. I don’t think that’s happened once since you got sucked into the hellhole that is the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : 大概……从来没有。自从你陷进女仆咖啡厅那个火坑之后，我觉得一次都没有过。

lines.en: : It’s not a hellhole, Io. I love working there. I’m just sad that it cuts into our time together. I like going on dates with you.
lines.zh: : 那不是火坑，Io。我喜欢在那儿工作。我只是难过它占掉了我们在一起的时间。我喜欢和你约会。

lines.en: : I literally just said that it wasn’t a date.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚明明说了这不是约会。

lines.en: : Noooo, you said you weren’t aiming for it to be a date.
lines.zh: : 不————，你说的是你没打算让它变成约会。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins6
: But seeing as I paid and I invited you out, I get to decide what we call it. We are on a date.
lines.zh: : 但既然是我付的钱、是我约你出来的，那叫什么就由我说了算。我们在约会。

lines.en: : Over Sensei already then? Am I the next obsession?
lines.zh: : 那已经把 Sensei 翻篇了？我是下一个执念了吗？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins7
: A date with him here does sound enticing, right? Holding hands as you go up the ferris wheel...kissing beneath the moon once you reach the top.
lines.zh: : 和他在这儿约会听起来确实很诱人，对吧？坐摩天轮的时候牵着手……到了顶端就在月光下接吻。

lines.en: : Mhm.
: We’re almost there, Io. Perhaps...we should-
lines.zh: : 我们快到了，Io。也许……我们应该——

lines.en: scene iofinallywins8
: No thanks! You’ll be the first to know if my sexuality magically changes, though. I’ll just keep waiting for the adult male I’ve decided to like to kiss me up here instead.
lines.zh: : 谢了不用！不过要是我的性取向奇迹般地变了，我会第一个告诉你的。在那之前，我就继续在这儿等着那个我决定要喜欢上的成年男性来亲我好了。

lines.en: : How’s that going, by the way? You went over to his house the other day, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，进展如何？你前几天去过他家了吧？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins9
: Yeah. We just sat in the dark and played games, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过我们只是坐在黑暗里打了会儿游戏。

lines.en: : So a perfect Io date?
lines.zh: : 那就是一场完美的 Io 式约会咯？

lines.en: : Nah. Not enough wood.
lines.zh: : 不。木头不够多。

lines.en: : Curious. I imagined a perfect Io date wouldn’t involve any wood at all.
lines.zh: : 有意思。我还以为一场完美的 Io 式约会根本不会涉及任何木头呢。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins10
: Ha ha ha. Bad Uta. I’m sending you to horny jail. You’ll need to roll doubles to escape and you can not collect $200 when you pass Go.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。坏 Uta。我要把你送进发情监狱。你得掷出对子才能出来，而且经过起点时不能收那 200 美元。

lines.en: : A boy and a girl...alone in the dark...huddled together in the glow of a computer...even that doesn’t get your blood pumping, Io?
lines.zh: : 一个男孩和一个女孩……独自在黑暗里……挤在一台电脑的微光中……就连那样都不能让你热血沸腾吗，Io？

lines.en: : It...does. Just not really in that way, you know?
lines.zh: : 会……会啊。只是不是那种意义上的，你知道吗？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins11
: Ugh. I wish I knew. I can’t even bump into the guy without wanting to get freaky anymore.
lines.zh: : 唉。我真希望我也懂。我现在只要撞上那家伙，就想跟他乱来。

lines.en: : That sounds horrible.
lines.zh: : 听起来糟透了。

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 确实。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins12
: But you know what isn’t? The fact that we can talk about it now.
lines.zh: : 但你知道什么不糟吗？我们现在可以谈论这件事了。

lines.en: : Yeah, there seems to be a lot less “internal struggle” going on with you ever since telling me about your feelings. I’m happy for you, Uta.
lines.zh: : 是啊，自从你跟我坦白了你的感情之后，你身上的「内心挣扎」好像少了很多。我为你高兴，Uta。

lines.en: : I’m happy for us, Io. There aren’t many best friends who’d be able to like the same guy and just openly talk about it like it’s no big deal at all. The fact that we can survive it just means we’re the best.
lines.zh: : 我为我们高兴，Io。没有多少最好的朋友能喜欢上同一个人，还能这么坦荡地聊它，就像这根本不算什么似的。我们能挺过来，正说明我们是最棒的。

lines.en: : Or that our thoughts on love and companionship have been mutilated beyond recognition due to our traumatic upbringings and resulted in an abnormally skewed perception of what it means to be with someone.
lines.zh: : 或者说明，我们对爱和陪伴的看法已经被我们创伤性的成长经历摧残得面目全非，导致我们对「和一个人在一起」意味着什么产生了异常扭曲的认知。

lines.en: : Don’t ruin it.
lines.zh: : 别破坏气氛。

lines.en: : But ruining things is my specialty.
lines.zh: : 可破坏气氛是我的专长啊。

lines.en: : Yeah! But for a second, I thought it was going to be mine since I’ve never had to admit to somebody I’m crushing on the same person as them before!
lines.zh: : 对！但有那么一瞬间，我以为那是我的专长了，毕竟我从来没跟别人坦白过——我和她迷恋上了同一个人！

lines.en: : I like how you didn’t refute the fact that ruining things is my specialty and just went along with it.
lines.zh: : 我欣赏你居然没有反驳「破坏气氛是我的专长」，而是直接顺着它说下去了。

lines.en: : There’s no use fighting with you when it comes to the way you think about yourself. I’ll only refute that if it’s someone else who says it.
lines.zh: : 在你怎么看待自己这件事上，跟你争是没有用的。只有别人这么说的时候，我才会反驳。

lines.en: : Regardless, I’m happy too. That we can talk about this. Even though I’ve kind of always been open to talking about it and was just unaware that you wanted to.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我也很高兴。高兴我们能聊这些。尽管我一直都挺愿意聊的，只是不知道你也想聊。

lines.en: : What do you think’s gonna happen if one of us actually gets him?
lines.zh: : 你觉得要是我们其中一个真的得到他了，会怎么样？

lines.en: : You mean if you actually get him? Sensei would never choose me as a partner, even if he does really care about me. I’m too lacking when it comes to aspects he actually requires in a person.
lines.zh: : 你是说如果你真的得到他吧？Sensei 永远不会选我做伴侣，就算他真的很在乎我。在他真正需要一个人具备的那些方面，我太欠缺了。

lines.en: : Like...the whole sex thing?
lines.zh: : 比如……性那方面？

lines.en: : Right. And the fact that there’s no way I could ever help him with any of his issues when you’ve seen how I handle mine. You, though? You’re great at that.
lines.zh: : 对。还有，你都看到了我自己那摊事都处理成什么样，我根本不可能帮得上他什么忙。但你可以啊。你很擅长那个。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins13
: I’m not great at anything, Io. We’re both screwed if getting help is going to be important to him. Especially since, on a baseline level, him getting help would effectively destroy our chances.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不擅长，Io。要是「寻求帮助」对他来说很重要，那我们俩都完蛋了。尤其是，从基线来看，他真去寻求帮助，实际上就等于毁了我们的机会。

lines.en: : Not mine if sex is the implication there. But also, you’re way wrong. You’ve helped me a ton, Uta.
lines.zh: : 如果是性那方面，我的机会倒还在。不过你可大错特错了。你帮了我很多，Uta。

lines.en: : And you’ve helped me a ton too. But that doesn’t mean we’re any good compared to everyone else in the running. Neither one of us is in the top five of the love journal.
lines.zh: : 你也帮了我很多啊。但这不意味着跟其他竞争者比起来我们有多好。我们俩谁都没进恋爱日记的前五名。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins14
: Buuuuuuuuut...if we combine forces?...
lines.zh: : 但但但……要是我们联手呢？……

lines.en: : You’re really gunning for this throuple thing, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的很想要那个三人行啊，是不是？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins15
: Just imagine it! All three of us on the ferris wheel! Me holding his hand and talking about how close to death we are while the two of you do, like...sex stuff.
lines.zh: : 想想看！我们三个一起坐摩天轮！我牵着他的手，讲我们离死亡有多近，而你们两个就做点，比如……性相关的事。

lines.en: : On a ferris wheel? Right next to you?
lines.zh: : 在摩天轮上？就在你旁边？

lines.en: : You would. You know it.
lines.zh: : 你会的。你心里清楚。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins16
: Yes, but I would not be proud.
lines.zh: : 是，但我不会为此感到骄傲。

lines.en: : Well, whatever happens Uta...I’m glad I get to go through it with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管将来发生什么，Uta……我很高兴能和你一起经历这些。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins17
: You really are the best thing that’s ever happened to me. And it is because we are so close to death that you can trust me when I say that.
lines.zh: : 你真的是我生命中发生过的最好的事。而正因为我们现在离死亡这么近，我说这话你才能信。

lines.en: : I’d trust you either way, Io. You’re the best thing that’s ever happened to me too.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样我都会信你的，Io。你也是我生命中发生过的最好的事。

lines.en: : Also, we’ve finally reached the top of the ferris wheel. So if you are looking to kiss someone up here-
lines.zh: : 还有，我们终于到摩天轮顶上了。所以如果你想在这儿亲谁的话——

lines.en: scene black
: I’m good, Uta. Also, this ferris wheel is, like...crazy slow, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我不需要，Uta。还有，这个摩天轮……是不是慢得离谱？

lines.en: : Right? We’ve barely moved this whole time.
lines.zh: : 就是说啊。我们这么半天几乎就没动过。

lines.en: The thing goes around and eventually completes a cycle or something and then the ride ends and then they get off of it because Uta needs to pee. Narration.
lines.zh: 那玩意儿转啊转，最后算是转完了一圈还是什么的，然后这个项目就结束了，然后她们从上面下来了，因为 Uta 要上厕所。旁白。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins18
: I need to pee!
lines.zh: : 我要上厕所！

lines.en: Also Blue Air comes on and changes the mood. Something is probably about to happen.
lines.zh: 而且 Blue Air 响了起来，气氛变了。大概马上要发生什么事了。

lines.en: : Why do you seem so proud of that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么看起来那么骄傲？

lines.en: : Because I held it in for what I can only imagine is the longest ferris wheel ride in all of Japan!
lines.zh: : 因为我憋住了，而这大概是全日本最长的一次摩天轮之旅！

lines.en: : Okay. Well, the bathroom is right there. So.
lines.zh: : 好吧。嗯，洗手间就在那儿。所以。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins19
: Aren’t you going to offer to come with me?
lines.zh: : 你不打算说陪我一起去吗？

lines.en: : Why would I do that?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Because we’re girls and that’s what girls do.
lines.zh: : 因为我们是女生啊，女生就是这么做的。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Well...because.
lines.zh: : 嗯……因为。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins20
: Okaaaay! Guess I’ll just go to the bathroom alone then! Sure hope nothing happens to me!
lines.zh: : 好————吧！那我就一个人去上厕所啦！真希望我不会出什么事！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins21
: But...after that? Rollercoasters.
lines.zh: : 不过……那之后呢？过山车。

lines.en: : Fuck yeah.
lines.zh: : 太他妈棒了。

lines.en: : We’re staying here until they kick us out tonight. I hope you’re ready, bitch.
lines.zh: : 我们要在这儿待到今晚他们把我们赶出去为止。希望你准备好了，贱人。

lines.en: : I was born ready, other bitch.
lines.zh: : 我生来就准备好了，另一个贱人。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins22
: Let’s not call each other “bitch” anymore. I love you too much.
lines.zh: : 我们别再互称「贱人」了。我太爱你了。

lines.en: : I love you too, Uta. That felt wrong and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，Uta。那感觉很不对，我很抱歉。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins23
: Kaybye! Be right back! Don’t go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 好，拜！马上回来！哪儿都别去！

lines.en: “Where would I even go in the first place?” she thought to herself, removing a phone from her pocket that she’d neglected to look at since approximately 2:00 PM.
lines.zh: 「我到底能去哪儿呢？」她心里想着，从口袋里掏出手机——她大约从下午两点起就没看过它了。

lines.en: She hadn’t received even a single notification within that time, though. Sensei must have been done playing that game and sending her progress updates.
lines.zh: 不过那段时间里她一条通知都没收到。Sensei 大概是玩完了那个游戏、不再给她发进度更新了。

lines.en: She didn’t expect him to ever go back to it without being pushed or reminded to, but she liked how he kept her in the loop for a whole night. Like he was actually thinking about her.
lines.zh: 她没指望他不推一把、不提醒就能自己回去接着玩，但她喜欢他花了一整晚让她知道进展。就好像他是真的在想着她。

lines.en: Which he probably wasn’t right now. And that made her want to text him. But she didn’t, because she thought that would be annoying. And this was essentially the only way Io ever used her phone in the first place.
lines.zh: 而他现在大概并没有在想她。这让她想给他发消息。但她没有，因为她觉得那样很烦人。而这基本上就是 Io 使用手机的唯一方式。

lines.en: Type something out. Erase it. Scroll through older messages. Scroll through her photo reel to find candid photos she’d taken of him from her desk when he used to come to school.
lines.zh: 打几个字。删掉。翻看更早的消息。翻看她的相册，找那些他还在上学时、她从自己课桌上偷拍他的照片。

lines.en: It wasn’t a good use of her time. But it was enough to bridge the gap between different bouts of nothingness on the way to something that might be good.
lines.zh: 这不是打发时间的好办法。但它足以填补通往某种也许不错的东西的路上，一段又一段虚无之间的缝隙。

lines.en: This was the best day she’d had in a long time, and he hadn’t even been involved. So why was there this urge to involve him now?
lines.zh: 这是她很久以来过得最好的一天，而他甚至没有参与其中。那么为什么现在会有这种想把他牵扯进来的冲动？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins24
She got caught up in this question for so long that she didn’t even notice she was being approached by two large men.
lines.zh: 她被困在这个问题里太久，以至于根本没注意到有两个高大的男人正朝她走来。

lines.en: They’d seen her at several points throughout the day. Her stupid hair made her stick out.
lines.zh: 他们一整天里已经在好几个地方看见过她。她那头蠢头发让她格外显眼。

lines.en: They joked among each other about using her twintails as handlebars for impure purposes. What they said about her friend was even worse.
lines.zh: 他们互相开着玩笑，说要把她的双马尾当车把，用于某些不纯洁的用途。他们对她朋友说的话甚至更不堪。

lines.en: But right now, they said nothing. They just stood in front of the girl, waiting for her to notice them.
lines.zh: 但此刻他们什么都没说。他们只是站在女孩面前，等她注意到他们。

lines.en: : Go away.
lines.zh: : 滚开。

lines.en: And then she did. But it was not in the way they wanted.
lines.zh: 然后她确实走了。只不过不是以他们想要的方式。

lines.en: : Go away? Can a guy not even walk up to a girl anymore without her trying to turn it into a thing?
lines.zh: : 滚开？现在一个男的连走到一个女的面前都不行了吗，非要她把这事搞大？

lines.en: : Maybe she’s deaf? Try-
lines.zh: : 也许她是聋子？试试——

lines.en: : Speaking louder and drawing attention to ourselves? Are you a fucking idiot? Just let me work my magic.
lines.zh: : 说更大声、把注意力全吸引到我们自己身上？你他妈是白痴吗？让我来搞定。

lines.en: : I hope it’s to make yourself disappear, because I want nothing to do with either of you.
lines.zh: : 但愿你的本事是让自己消失，因为我跟你们两个一点关系都不想有。

lines.en: : Aaaah, so you can hear us after all. What are you up to? Where’d your friend go?
lines.zh: : 啊——，这么说你还是听得见我们的。你在忙什么呢？你朋友去哪儿了？

lines.en: : Home. And my ride will be here any second now, so you should probably leave.
lines.zh: : 回家了。而且我的车马上就到，所以你们最好还是走吧。

lines.en: : The hell’s your problem? All we did was walk up to you.
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么毛病？我们不过是走过来而已。

lines.en: : Yeah. We just wanted to see if you and you and your friend wanted to go somewhere together.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们只是想看看你和你朋友想不想一起去什么地方。

lines.en: : Welp. She’s not here, so I guess that defeats the purpose. Bye.
lines.zh: : 唔。她不在，那看来是没戏了。拜拜。

lines.en: : How about just you?
lines.zh: : 就你一个人怎么样？

lines.en: : Yeah. Think you can handle both of us, little girl?
lines.zh: : 是啊。你觉得你应付得了我俩吗，小丫头？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins25
: Don’t creep her out, man. You’re coming on too strong.
lines.zh: : 别把她吓着了，哥们。你上得太猛了。

lines.en: : But that’s what-
lines.zh: : 可那才是——

lines.en: : Yeah, I know what the goal is. But that’s not how this works. Just let me do the talking.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道目标是什么。但这事不是这么办的。让我来说。

lines.en: : Why are you even here?...Shouldn’t you be in space or something?
lines.zh: : 你们到底来这儿干什么？……你们不是该在太空什么的吗？

lines.en: : Space? You kidding? Do we look like the type to get roped into that bullshit? You should see the car I pulled up in. It’d get you wetter than the log flume.
lines.zh: : 太空？你开玩笑吧？我们看起来像是会被那种破事拉去的人吗？你该看看我开来的那辆车。它能把你弄得比激流勇进还湿。

lines.en: : Yeah. And I’m the one who comes on too strong.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我还上得太猛呢。

lines.en: : Fuck off.
lines.zh: : 滚蛋。

lines.en: : I’m asexual.
lines.zh: : 我是无性恋。

lines.en: : Translation — I ain’t had a good dick yet.
lines.zh: : 翻译一下——她还没尝过好鸡巴呢。

lines.en: : Probably hasn’t had one at all. She’s a sophomore, max.
lines.zh: : 大概根本就没尝过。她顶多是个二年级的。

lines.en: : I bet her friend has. She looked like she could handle both of us. This one’s just a prude.
lines.zh: : 我打赌她朋友尝过。她看起来能同时应付我们俩。这个就是个假正经。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins26
: Whatcha looking at on your phone there? Mind showing us?
lines.zh: : 你在手机上看什么呢？介意给我们看看吗？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins27
: In fact, why not just give us your phone? I won’t keep it, I promise. I just want to put my contact info in there.
lines.zh: : 说真的，干脆把手机给我们吧？我不会留着的，我保证。我只是想把我的联系方式存进去。

lines.en: : Daisuke, hold up. There’s someone-
lines.zh: : Daisuke，等等。有人——

lines.en: : It’s fine. We’re not doing anything wrong. We’re just talking to our new friend here. What’s your name? I don’t bite.
lines.zh: : 没事。我们又没做什么坏事。我们只是在跟这儿的新朋友聊聊天。你叫什么名字？我不咬人的。

lines.en: : Leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 离我远点。

lines.en: : What was that? I couldn’t hear you.
lines.zh: : 你说什么？我没听清。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins28
: I said...leave me a-
lines.zh: : 我说……离我远——

lines.en: : You ain’t...gotta say shit...to punks like them.
lines.zh: : 你……用不着……跟他们这种混混……废话。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins29
: Huh? Who-
: Oh, fuck! Isn’t that-
lines.zh: : 哦，操！那不是——

lines.en: scene iofinallywins30
: W-What are you doing, you crazy bitch?! His bones are made of glass!
lines.zh: : 你、你在干什么，你这个疯婆子？！他的骨头是玻璃做的！

lines.en: : Well...he should’ve thought about that...before pickin’ on a fuckin’ high school girl!
lines.zh: : 那他……就该在招惹一个……操蛋的高中女生之前……想清楚！

lines.en: : My...fragile...everything! I can’t move!
lines.zh: : 我……浑身……都碎了！我动不了了！

lines.en: : Yuki?! What are you-
lines.zh: : Yuki？！你在——

lines.en: : Leave them...to me! I...can handle this!
lines.zh: : 把他们……交给我！我……能搞定！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins31
: Is he bleeding out of his eyes?
lines.zh: : 他在从眼睛里流血吗？

lines.en: : If he ain’t already...he’s about to be!
lines.zh: : 要是还没有……也快了！

lines.en: : N-No! Don’t! Stop! Please!
lines.zh: : 不、不要！别！住手！求你了！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins32
: Daisuke! No! His eyes were made of glass too!
lines.zh: : Daisuke！不！他的眼睛也是玻璃做的！

lines.en: : Omar! I can’t see! I can’t fucking see!
lines.zh: : Omar！我看不见了！我他妈看不见了！

lines.en: : I’ve got you, buddy! I’ve got you!
lines.zh: : 我扶着你，兄弟！我扶着你！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins33
: Yeah...take him. And while you’re at it, do yourselves a fuckin’ favor and...never come around here again...you got that?
lines.zh: : 是啊……带他走。还有，顺便给自己积点德，……别再在这一带出现了……听到了吗？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! You’ll never see us again! Just p...please! D...Don’t tell the boss we-
lines.zh: : 是、是！你们再也见不到我们了！求……求你了！别……别跟老大说我们——

lines.en: : Do you want some too?! Huh?!
lines.zh: : 你也想来一份吗？！啊？！

lines.en: : Aaaah! No! Don’t hurt me!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！不！别伤害我！

lines.en: : Omar...I...I can see the light...
lines.zh: : Omar……我……我看见光了……

lines.en: : Hang in there, Daisuke! Hang in there!
lines.zh: : 撑住，Daisuke！撑住！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins34
: Yuki! That...was so fucking cool! Like, where did you even come from?! If I wasn’t seconds away from having a panic attack, I’d-
lines.zh: : Yuki！那……太他妈帅了！话说，你到底是从哪儿冒出来的？！要不是我差点就要惊恐发作了，我都想——

lines.en: scene iofinallywins35
: Hah....hah....haah...
: Yuki?...
lines.zh: : Yuki？……

lines.en: : Is everything...alright?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins36
: Never...better...
lines.zh: : 再好不过了……

lines.en: : You look terrible...Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 你看起来糟透了……出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene iofinallywins37
: Forget about me...what are you doing here...alone?...
lines.zh: : 别管我……你一个人在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : I’m with Uta. She just went into the bathroom and....what...what are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 我和 Uta 一起。她刚进洗手间，然后……什么……你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Meeting...someone...
: Those guys come up to you...outta nowhere?...
lines.zh: : 那些家伙是突然……凑上来的？……

lines.en: : I...yeah. I was just waiting here and-
lines.zh: : 我……嗯。我就在这儿等着，然后——

lines.en: : That happens again...just tell ‘em...you know me...
lines.zh: : 再发生这种事……就跟他们说……你认识我……

lines.en: : You got it?...
lines.zh: : 记住了吗？……

lines.en: : Yuki...you’re so pale...I really think you should-
lines.zh: : Yuki……你脸色好白……我真的觉得你应该——

lines.en: : I’m fine...but....I’ve...gotta go...
lines.zh: : 我没事……但是……我……得走了……

lines.en: scene black
: Remember...say my name...if shit...mngh...gets...bad!
lines.zh: : 记住……说我的名字……要是事情……嗯……变糟了！

lines.en: scene iofinallywins38
: Io! What happened?! I heard yelling! But I was already in the middle of stuff and-
lines.zh: : Io！出什么事了？！我听到有人在喊！但我当时正在上厕所上到一半，然后——

lines.en: scene iofinallywins39
: Is that Yumi’s mom? What’s she doing here?
lines.zh: : 那是 Yumi 的妈妈？她在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : She...saved me from...these two fucking creepy guys...
lines.zh: : 她……救了我……从那两个该死的变态手里……

lines.en: scene iofinallywins40
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : One of them had glass bones. It was weird.
lines.zh: : 其中一个有玻璃骨头。好奇怪。

lines.en: : You’re okay though? They didn’t hurt you? They didn’t touch you? I’m sorry I wasn’t here. If I knew, I-
lines.zh: : 你没事吧？他们没伤到你吧？他们没碰你吧？对不起我不在那儿。我要是知道，我就——

lines.en: scene iofinallywins41
: Would have held it in forever?
lines.zh: : 就能憋上一辈子？

lines.en: : If that’s what it takes to protect you.
lines.zh: : 只要能保护你，怎样都行。

lines.en: scene iofinallywins42
: I’m fine, Uta. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Uta。谢谢你。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: But I...
lines.zh: : 可是我……

lines.en: : I’m worried about Yuki...
lines.zh: : 我好担心 Yuki……

lines.en: : I’ve never seen her so-
lines.zh: : 我从来没见过她那样——

lines.en: : Tell me at home. The bus just pulled up. We should catch it before it leaves.
lines.zh: : 回家再跟我说。公交车刚到站了。我们得赶在它开走前上车。

lines.en: : What? But I thought you said they’d have to kick us out-
lines.zh: : 什么？可你不是说要等他们把我们赶出去——

lines.en: : That was before you were apparently almost abducted! We’ll come back for the rollercoasters soon. It’s not safe tonight.
lines.zh: : 那是在你差点被绑架之前！过山车我们改天再来补上。今晚不安全。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Hot dogs. Konbini. As many as you want.
lines.zh: : 热狗。便利店。想吃多少都行。

lines.en: : Ugh. You’re lucky I’m hungry.
lines.zh: : 唉。算你走运，我饿了。

lines.en: : I’m lucky you’re safe. Now, come on. Hold my hand.
lines.zh: : 是我走运，你平安无事。好了，走吧。牵着我的手。

lines.en: : Do I really have to-
lines.zh: : 我真的非得——

lines.en: : Hold my fucking hand, bitch!
lines.zh: : 牵住我他妈的手，贱人！

lines.en: scene black
: Wow. That was the shortest pact we’ve ever made, other bitch.
lines.zh: : 哇。这是我们立过的最短的一个约定了，另一个贱人。

lines.en: : I’m sorry and I love you. Again.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉，还有我爱你。再说一次。

lines.en: : I love you too. Again. But love can wait! It’s wiener time!
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。再说一次。但爱可以等！现在是热狗时间！

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
: Did somebody say “wiener time?”
lines.zh: : 有人说「热狗时间」吗？

lines.en: : ...Wait, what?
lines.zh: : ……等等，什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Why did I just jump out of bed to say that? That’s not even the line.
lines.zh: : 我为什么刚从床上跳起来说那句话？那甚至都不是我的台词啊。

lines.en: Somewhere else, two girls were safe.
lines.zh: 在别的地方，两个女孩是安全的。

lines.en: One woman wasn’t.
lines.zh: 一个女人不是。
